newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Samara aluminium eyes 1997 output boost.
newsitem.headline: Russian Samara aluminium eyes 1997 output boost.

text.p: The Samara Metallurgical Company (SAMECO), Russia's biggest aluminium processor, plans to boost 1997 rolled aluminium output to 134,700 tonnes from 76,900 tonnes in 1996, a senior company official said on Thursday.

Vice-president Igor Kurlanov, quoted by Interfax news agency in Samara, said last year's output slipped 50.8 percent on 1995's level, and blamed high domestic primary aluminium costs and low domestic demand.

The company, known in Russian as AO Samarskaya Metallurgicheskaya Kompaniya, plans to export 92,700 tonnes of rolled aluminium products this year, or 68.8 percent of planned output. Its 1996 exports were 40,800 tonnes.
Rolled aluminium is SAMECO's main product, comprising 85-90 percent of output. The company buys primary aluminium feed from the Krasnoyarsk aluminium smelter.
